name: claudelets-agent-monitor
description: Live pane of the current request: % complete, tokens and what each agent and subagent is doing, with a pixel Claude per agent dressed for its job; toasts (silently) when Claude needs you, gets stuck or finishes; masks secrets; finish summary and a 30-day request history

pollSeconds.title: Usage refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often ctx, 5h and 7d are re-read. 5h/7d come from your account usage, so other sessions count too; 0 turns polling off
